name: Shipping agents and port services

problems.words: DO release queue at our counter is always full
quick_ideas: Publish the list of documents needed for a DO, so customers arrive ready
Accept documents by email ahead of the visit, so counter time is shorter.

workzap_build.text: An online DO request and payment flow with document upload and status messages, cutting counter visits.

problems.free_stops: The request and approval flow is designed in the solution document.

problems.words: Customers can't see their detention charges until they come to pay
quick_ideas: Tell each customer their free-time end date at DO release, so charges don't surprise them
List containers close to free-time end today.

workzap_build.text: Live free-time countdowns and detention estimates sent to the customer on WhatsApp automatically.

problems.free_stops: Message timing is set in the solution document.

problems.words: Detention invoices are calculated by hand and often wrong
quick_ideas: Re-check a few recent detention invoices, so you see how often and where errors happen
Keep one current tariff reference everyone uses.

workzap_build.text: A detention and demurrage calculator per container using gate-out and return dates.

problems.free_stops: How the calculation is set up is in the solution document.

problems.words: Empties aren't returned and we lose track of containers
quick_ideas: List containers out with customers and their days out, so overdue ones show
Name one person for equipment follow-up.

workzap_build.text: A container movement tracker (gate out, with customer, returned to depot) with overdue alerts and an equipment balance view by port.

problems.free_stops: The movement stages and alerts are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Principals pay FDAs late and we fund port costs
quick_ideas: Total what you have funded for each principal now, so the exposure is clear
Raise PDA funding before vessel arrival as your agreement allows.

workzap_build.text: A principal receivables tracker with ageing and settlement status.

problems.free_stops: Ageing and follow-up rules are in the solution document.

problems.words: Disbursement accounts take weeks to finalise
quick_ideas: List the port invoices still outstanding on each open call, so you see what's holding FDAs
Name who chases each.

workzap_build.text: A PDA/FDA builder that collects port invoices as they arrive and shows what's still outstanding.

problems.free_stops: How invoices are collected into each FDA is designed in the solution document.

problems.words: Boarding officer updates come by phone and get lost
quick_ideas: Ask boarding officers to send updates in one shared place, so the office sees them
Keep a short log per vessel call.

workzap_build.text: A vessel call board with ETA, berth, boarding updates, tasks and responsible staff.

problems.free_stops: The board's structure is set in the solution document.

problems.words: Every customer emails for the same arrival information
quick_ideas: Count a day's arrival enquiries, so you see the load
Send arrival details to consignees once, proactively.

workzap_build.text: Automatic arrival notices to consignees from the manifest.

problems.free_stops: What notices include and when they go is set in the solution document.

problems.words: Customers dispute detention, saying they returned the box on time
quick_ideas: Ask the depot for return dates daily rather than every few days, so records are current
Keep proof of each return with the container record.

workzap_build.text: Depot return data flowing into your records daily, so each dispute can be checked against a dated record.

problems.free_stops: How depot data connects is mapped in the solution document.

problems.words: Approval of waivers on detention goes through too many people
quick_ideas: Write down who can approve what level of waiver, so requests go to one person
Note the reason on every waiver given.

workzap_build.text: A waiver approval workflow with reasons and limits by role.

problems.free_stops: Approval limits are set in the solution document.

problems.words: I can't see vessel calls, revenues and costs per principal in one view
quick_ideas: Pick the few numbers each principal asks about, so reporting covers what matters
Pull last month's figures once.

workzap_build.text: A principal view and KPI report pack produced from operational data.

problems.free_stops: What the report pack contains is set in the solution document.

never_say: Anything on maritime law, charter party terms, laytime disputes, P&I or cargo claims.
Sanctions screening of vessels, cargo, owners or destinations, or any way around it.
Crew changes, visas or shore passes; never store crew details.
Help releasing cargo without proper authority or "managing" officials.
Storing customer and principal financial details. For port incidents, injuries, fires, spills or medical emergencies on board, emergency services and the port authority come first.

sample_reply.person: We're agents for two lines in Jebel Ali and detention disputes are killing us. Customers swear they returned empties earlier than our records. Any fix?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, disputes like these can be settled much faster, and you can start this week. 1. Ask the depot for return dates every day rather than every few days, so your records are current. 2. Keep proof of each return with the container record, so every dispute is checked against something dated. Workzap can do this automatically for you: depot return data flowing in daily, with a free-time countdown each customer sees on WhatsApp. Shall I have a solution document and quote prepared for you? You're welcome to say no.
